nodes.label: Privacy-First Fully Local Architecture
nodes.rationale: All data stored locally in SQLite; no external cloud services required; Ollama used for local LLM inference; optional local API keys for market data (user-provided). Design choice prioritizes data privacy over convenience of cloud services.

nodes.label: Layered System Architecture (Presentation, API, DB, AI, External Data)
nodes.rationale: Architecture is split into presentation layer (Next.js, Tauri, Capacitor), API layer (FastAPI), database layer (SQLite), AI/LLM layer (Ollama), and external data layer (Yahoo Finance, Alpha Vantage, Stooq). Each layer is independently deployable.
